name: SVR Poker Android

realDeviceValidation.reportedIssue: APK-hosted Android web game freezes before a full game is completed
realDeviceValidation.target: Complete multiple hands and NEXT HAND without a frozen screen or controls
changes: Removed background deferred lobby/account/FBX avatar/presence loading
Replaced repeated full-scene scans with one bounded scan
Added frame-gap and WebGL context recovery
Capped normal Android pixel ratio at 1.0 and recovery mode at 0.78

updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 356 changes the remotely loaded Android web runtime and does not require reinstalling APK 0.1.0-rc1.
The owner reported a real Android freeze, so the earlier browser smoothness result is retained only as historical automated acceptance and is not treated as real-device proof.
Android no longer runs shader compileAsync after the table appears.
Android no longer loads lobby decoration, account, FBX avatar, or network presence modules in the background during play.
Five low-poly table avatars provide visual players without FBX downloads or animation overhead.
A frame-gap watchdog lowers rendering resolution and exposes Continue Low Power and Reload Table recovery controls.
The single Phase 347 MOVE/LOOK/action controller remains authoritative.
APK version name 0.1.0-rc1, version code 1, manual-update-only, forceUpdate false, and showUpdatePrompt false remain locked.
No native Android wrapper source, signing identity, or installable RC2 APK is currently present in the repository.
